title: Lineage/Subspecies Inheritance and Composition
objective: Define deterministic parent/lineage deltas, overrides, exclusions, grant stacking and composition order without copying full parent records or guessing conflicts.
acceptance: lineages do not copy full parent records
conflicts are surfaced rather than guessed
boundaries: MVPS-08 owns lineage/subspecies inheritance and composition semantics only.
Base species identity remains MVPS-01 and species choice semantics remain MVPS-02.
Morphology, scale/movement/senses, physiology, natural equipment and compatibility consume MVPS-03 through MVPS-07 by stable reference/delta rather than copied mechanics.
Form/transformation runtime remains MVPS-09; species progression remains MVPS-10; runtime active-contribution projection remains MVPS-13.
MVPS-09+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
next_action: MVPS-08 is completed_verified. MVPS-09 is selected_not_started with no implementation branch or authority and requires a later owner Continue.
